intro: For wholesalers, RV converters and import agents. Compare configurations and build a trial order that meets each model’s minimum quantity, then plan replenishment and export from China.
trial: Trial orders follow the minimum for each model and configuration: 20 units for the priced air conditioners; 300 units for UOG-30 and both aluminium-fridge versions. Other catalogue models are quoted individually.

packingPending: Unconfirmed packing measurements are excluded from freight estimates.

trustTitle: Long-term factory partners. Experienced export coordination.
trust: DDNZ selects products from long-term strategic factory partners in China. Heaven Born International Freight (HB), operating since 1997, contributes nearly three decades of international freight experience to order coordination, consolidation and export.
priceValue: Compare wholesale prices on the same basis: exact model, voltage, operating mode, quantity and included kit. Trial orders and repeat orders use the confirmed supply conditions for their configuration.
fridgeNames: 34 L aluminium fridge · VIP + PU insulation
fridgeUses: Two lids and independently controlled zones. An optional battery compartment replaces the smaller temperature zone.
PU foam insulation, a magnetic divider and an aluminium body for camping and vehicle assortments.
VIP vacuum panels with PU foam; select this insulation version separately from the PU-only version.
A compact footprint and lower lifting weight for vehicle-accessory wholesale ranges.
A 300 mm body height for vehicle layouts where clearance matters.
25 L refrigerated compartment plus a 9.5 L freezer; compare the actual storage split.
45 L capacity in a stainless-steel body; allow for a 23 kg empty weight.
65 L capacity with separate temperature zones for larger outdoor assortments.
100 L storage; allow for the 1,000 mm body length and 35 kg empty weight.

acUses: Compact compressor cooling for tent accessories, RV converters and camping wholesalers.
Khaki finish and a square grille for an entry-price outdoor cooling range.
Higher cooling capacity for RV, tent and temporary-space assortments.
featureTitles: Choose PU or VIP + PU insulation
featureTexts: Select cooling-only or cooling & heating together with the 110 V or 220 V version. Heating belongs to the corresponding configuration.
Condensate evaporation reduces drainage frequency. Keep the drain accessible in humid conditions and during long operating periods.
SOG-1 materials show a digital panel, two fan speeds and a 24-hour timer. A carry handle and adjustable outlet support everyday use.
Detach the front filter to clear dust and hair, and keep the air path clean.
The SOG-1 materials include a separate dehumidification mode for damp conditions.
The removable magnetic divider switches the aluminium fridge between one zone and two independently controlled zones.
PU foam: CNY 2,230 per unit. VIP + PU: CNY 2,330 per unit. Each insulation version starts at 300 units.
The aluminium design includes lid support, side handles, interior lighting, a drain outlet and optional baskets, silicone pads and ice bricks.
acScenes: Match tent size, insulation and ambient temperature to the configuration. Route exhaust outside the cooled space.
The twelve priced versions use AC power. Plan a compatible supply, hose routing and ventilation.
A self-contained unit needs no separate outdoor condenser but still requires an exhaust path.
fridgeScenes: Specify daily use, storage load and the available power source for a camping assortment.
Check body dimensions, lid clearance, securing points and the specified 12/24 V supply.
Use a matched AC adapter for supplementary storage; include ventilation space in the layout.
customTexts: Choose the finish and colour; quote exterior changes and tooling separately.
Specify logo placement and approve the artwork on the sample.
Choose panel language and operating controls.
App, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and voice controls are optional development configurations.
Specify destination plug, voltage, frequency and included power accessories.
Provide carton artwork, manual language, barcodes and packing requirements.
procurement: Keep model, electrical version, quantity, included accessories and packaging on each order line. Combine accepted lines for shipment without changing their individual minimums.
Use the confirmed supply conditions for the order, including lead time and customization. Align sample approval, inspection and collection before export.
Compare measured performance at the intended ambient temperature and load. Rated input watts are not a daily energy-consumption figure.
Confirm actual carton dimensions and gross weight for freight planning. Keep batteries, chargers and optional accessories as separate order items.

trialFridge: UOG-30 and each aluminium-fridge insulation version start at 300 units. Minimums for the other catalogue models are quoted individually.
